assessment: This paper is of interest to biochemists and those focused on development of novel antibiotics. The authors present two small molecules that specifically target the essential ribonucleotide reductase of the causative agent of gonorrhea. Biochemical, biophysical, and biological data support the efficacy of these molecules both in vitro and in mouse models. Overall, this is a comprehensive study providing insights that may guide the development of new therapies for gonorrhea.
